purpose: Tells whether a served relation role is a given role, with or without its `role:` prefix, and names the shape of one relation a record takes part in.
namedChanges: Comments made generic: "reverse-lookup" became "the platform's reverse lookup", "(Base reverse-lookup additive field)" became "(an additive field of the platform's reverse lookup)", a leading internal tag was dropped from the `type` comment, and "GilbPlatform sends it" became "The platform sends it".
